## Before you post

This repository and all submissions are PUBLIC. A GitHub account is needed to submit.
Partial contributions are welcome. Write **Unknown** or **Not applicable** instead of guessing.
Use one submission per vehicle configuration or yard layout. Do not combine measurements from different trucks or tandem settings.

- [ ] I have permission to share this information and any attached material.
- [ ] I removed VINs, plates, license numbers, contact details, student records, and other identifying information from text/photos/documents, including location metadata where relevant.
- [ ] My submission separates measured facts, published specifications, estimates, and personal observations.
- [ ] I understand that submission does not mean acceptance as approved simulator ground truth.

Do not measure while driving, use a phone while driving, go under a vehicle, reposition equipment, or perform a maneuver solely for this request. Share existing records or measurements obtainable safely on secured, parked equipment with permission. Leave anything unsafe or inaccessible unknown.

## 3. Measurements or documented specifications

For each value, include units and exact endpoints. For tandem wheelbase/axle distances, specify which axle center or tandem midpoint you used. Distinguish steering-wheel rotation from road-wheel angle. An estimated number must not be labeled measured.

| Item | Value and units | Exact endpoints/definition | Method or document/page | Date and uncertainty/confidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tractor wheelbase | Unknown | | | |
| Tractor overall length | Unknown | | | |
| Fifth-wheel/kingpin location relative to a named tractor reference | Unknown | | | |
| Steering range (state steering wheel or road wheel) | Unknown | | | |
| Trailer kingpin to rear | Unknown | | | |
| Trailer kingpin to axle center(s) or tandem midpoint | Unknown | | | |
| Trailer rear overhang (define axle reference) | Unknown | | | |
| Tractor/trailer mass and loading condition | Unknown | | | |
| Other | Unknown | | | |

Attach a labeled sketch or redacted photo if available. Never invent a missing number.

A driver's recollection is useful context but is not an official rule. Please do not upload restricted school/exam materials or entire copyrighted manuals; use an authorized public link and page reference.

## Maintainer review (leave for reviewers)

- [ ] Scope, units, endpoints, configuration, source rights, and privacy checked
- [ ] Measured/documented facts separated from estimates and observations
- [ ] Relevant source/jurisdiction/version checked
- [ ] Conflicts or contradictory reports documented without averaging incompatible configurations
- [ ] Qualified human review completed with reviewer, date, scope, and evidence
- [ ] Project-owner approval recorded for any ground-truth change
- [ ] Approved values, if any, proposed through a traceable reviewed change linked here

Default status: **Unverified community contribution**. Do not copy submissions automatically into `ground_truth/SIMULATOR_GROUND_TRUTH.md`.
